title: Binary search trees
learn: BST property, search/insert/delete O(h), inorder = sorted, validate with bounds
hook: Validate BST, Kth Smallest in a BST and LCA of a BST are classic mediums. They reward knowing two facts cold: the ordering applies to whole subtrees, and inorder traversal is sorted.

explain.prompt: Explain how to validate a binary search tree, and why comparing each node only with its children isn't enough.
keyPoints: BST property: every value in the left subtree < node < every value in the right subtree
comparing with direct children misses violations deeper down (a small value deep in a right subtree)
pass down an allowed (low, high) range; left child gets high = node, right child gets low = node
alternatively check that inorder traversal is strictly increasing
